4940:soul:2140.rationale: 原文明示己方下只出战精灵，不能以当前对手代替。
4940:soul:2140.singleBehavior: 回合开始严格高半免麻痹与成功清回合清强；实际麻痹准入记录、死亡继承条件已实现验证。
4940:soul:2140.deferredBehavior: 实际下一只己方出场获得本场永久免麻痹，换宠重建本次在场记录。
4940:soul:2140.trigger: 自身被击败且本次在场实际受到过麻痹。
futureMechanisms: 队伍与真实下一只出场
跨精灵永久免疫状态传递
再次登场在场记录生命周期

dependencyEvidence.quote: 则己方下只出战精灵本场战斗免疫麻痹状态

success.name: 4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹
success.assertion: test('4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹',()=>{for(const hp of[4500,4501]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,hp===4500?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],hp===4500);}});

success.name: 4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦
success.assertion: test('4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp:high?9000:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(high)c.hurt(c.t,7000,'回初快照降体','direct');else c.heal(c.t,9000,'回初快照回体','soul');c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],!high);}const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,false);});

success.name: 4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合
success.assertion: test('4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中']);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],undefined);});

success.name: 4940初始入场发生的麻痹真实记录，不把尚未开始的回合免疫提前执行
success.assertion: test('4940初始入场发生的麻痹真实记录，不把尚未开始的回合免疫提前执行',()=>{const s=observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1)c.entryAilment(c.t,'麻痹',3,c.a);},()=>make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true}));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.immuneRound,0);});

success.name: 4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强
success.assertion: test('4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强',()=>{for(const reflect of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(reflect)timer(s,0,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,reflect?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],reflect);}});

success.name: 4940被实际击败仅在本次入场曾实际麻痹时登记下只永久免麻痹，不赋给当前对手
success.assertion: test('4940被实际击败仅在本次入场曾实际麻痹时登记下只永久免麻痹，不赋给当前对手',()=>{for(const hp of[1,9000]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{spe:10,def:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spe:1000}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].soulState.guardianInheritance2140,hp===1);if(hp===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardianInheritance2140.requiresActualNextAlly,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.guardianInheritance2140,undefined);}});

success.assertion: test('4940/2492双方真实盾罩合计相等才当回合封属，全部被清，不相等不封，零对零待答回滚',()=>{for(const equal of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2492));S.refresh(s.fighters[0],10,'a');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],20,'b');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[0],equal?30:29,'c');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);for(const f of s.fighters){assert.equal(f.suitState.shield??0,0);assert.equal(f.suitState.barrier??0,0);}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,equal?0:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].soulState.noVoluntarySwitch2492,equal);if(equal)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.noVoluntarySwitch2492.requiresRealSwitch,true);}const s=make(row(2492));assert.throws(()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117),/Q-4940-001/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(s.auditMoveId)],5);});

success.assertion: test('4940全部22招各16种子完整操作链HP/PP及原生2140首轮免麻痹；2492仅准备不等盾已知分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];if(m.id===29440)S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1,'known-unequal');turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});if(m.id===29440)S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1,'known-unequal');turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.immuneRound,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,false);}});
